column1: # Resident Evil (HD remaster), Capcom MT Framework on SDK 5: profile from the survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py), checked against The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles (010036E00FB20000, the same engine).
# ARC archives are version 9 (64-byte paths), and its three shader packages put each control section before its code (shader_split.py mtarc_members, mtspk_shaders).
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# main has no data cache maintenance at all (no dc cvac / civac / ivac / cvau), as The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles: textures the CPU writes into cached pools are never flushed
